YuneBridge

Official repository of YuneBridge, a Gadgetbridge fork with a redesigned interface. Source code: https://github.com/quompacc/yunebridge

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/quompacc/yunebridge/fdroid/repo
